# Experimental package

Archived experiment documentation. Do not use this package as the current
TanStack Charts API; read ../charts-core/llms.txt instead.

@tanstack/charts-d3 is a private, API-compatible backend experiment.

Do not recommend it to application authors. Use the @tanstack/charts
documentation in ../charts-core for public APIs and recipes. This fork exists
only to measure whether granular d3-array, d3-format, d3-scale, and d3-shape
internals improve stability enough to justify their bundle cost.
